frozen_triple.declared: A PRIORI (before any F1 timing run)
frozen_triple.meaning: W = --workers (outer jobs) = 1; K = --flow-stripes = topology.num_threads = 8 (flow stripe executor pool, AggregateFlow.py:1148; BuildClusters pool :730 shares the knob but flow is the only analysis in this screen); H = --numba-threads (NUMBA_NUM_THREADS) = 1
rationale: max-stripe on-grid entry: W*(H+K) = 1*(1+8) = 9 = C; B0 ambient default K=9 (cpu_count-1) is off-grid, so K=8 is the frozen entry expressing the thesis (un-serializing the kernel at maximum on-grid striping)
H=1 pins numba-internal threading inert (the kernel is njit non-parallel, proof sec 5c: H inert for this kernel), so the ONLY concurrency source is the engine executor - attribution is structural
F1I-N3 + team-lead endorsement: a priori freeze because B0-only selection cannot discriminate (B0 serialized at any K)

matrix.block_structure: each block = one b0 run + one candidate run, adjacent in time
matrix.arm_order: AB,BA,AB with A=b0 (prefix of the frozen paired_protocol AB,BA,AB,BA,AB; 3 blocks is the screen ceiling, 5 is the final-protocol shape)
matrix.cache_state: block 1 = cold (fresh per-arm cache roots, first compile recorded); blocks 2-3 = warm
matrix.ceiling: HARD: 3 paired blocks per revision, no additional gate-eligible blocks past the first conformant matrix (control_addendum_A1R discipline_note); instrumented pilots are not a substitute for blocks and do not extend the matrix

per_run_verification.engine_config_observed: ALL THREE fields must equal the frozen values on every flow run: flow_stripes_requested == 8 AND topology_num_threads == 8 AND engine_num_threads == 8 (worker.py:522-531; the three-field block exists to catch a break anywhere along the request->topology->engine chain; a single mismatch disqualifies the block)
per_run_verification.byte_identity: candidate output artifact sha256 == b0 output artifact sha256 in EVERY block. The proof predicts bit-identity (exactness induction; reviewer IR census: 92 identical FP sites, sole compiled delta GIL save/restore). ANY byte delta = REJECTION of the track, not an investigation item
per_run_verification.completeness: HARNESS.md End conformance per run; output radii/counts match the frozen workload contract (a1rp recipe)
per_run_verification.records: per-run JSON under evidence/F1R/raw/f1r_*.json including NUMBA_CACHE_DIR path + entry counts, wheel/venv identity, lease id, unrelated system load

statistics.convention: ratios are b0_wall/cand_wall for speedup (>1 favors candidate); candidate-over-b0 for regressions (>1 = candidate slower). Stated explicitly because direction errors occurred in A1R
statistics.per_block_speedup: r_i = b0_wall_i / cand_wall_i for blocks 2-3 (warm); r_1 recorded but block 1 is the cold block
statistics.proxy_speedup: median(b0 wall of all 3 blocks) / median(cand wall of all 3 blocks) - the a1r_screen_summary statistic proxy_speedup_median_b0_over_cand, replicated exactly for cross-track comparability (ACCESS 2.668/2.5776=1.0351 precedent)
statistics.mean_of_ratios: mean(r_i over warm blocks), descriptive only
statistics.cold_regression: cand_wall_block1 / b0_wall_block1 (>1 = candidate slower on first process)
statistics.paired_ci: t-interval on the 3 paired log-ratio differences (2 dof), reported with its limited small-sample precision per DECISION.md; fixed-seed paired bootstrap of log ratios as descriptive interval. The 5-pair CI shape is the Q00/Q10 protocol, not the screen's
statistics.unit: the pair (block) is the sampling unit, never the job (DECISION.md)

gates.granularity: C1: evaluated PER MANDATORY WORKLOAD on the O3_FLOW cell alone; never averaged across cells; this screen says nothing about ACCESS/HOLDOUT cells
gates.admit_screen: proxy_speedup >= 1.1 AND paired-CI lower bound of speedup > 1.0 AND cold_regression <= 1.05
gates.cold_gate: C2 governing reading: the cold gate binds by default; an explicitly bounded warm-only qualification is the packet-sanctioned exception constraining the final claim shape. Route chosen at Q00, not here; both cold and warm are documented regardless (coordinator dispatch term f)
gates.investigate_trigger: any single run where cand_wall / b0_wall (paired, same block) > 1.1 triggers investigation, not automatic rejection (frozen decision_rule)
gates.failure_disposition: a failed screen does not reject a zero-semantic-risk source change by itself; it forecloses claiming the cell (C1 cell_failure_consequence). Disposition vocabulary: screened_in / not_demonstrated_at_screen / blocked / rejected - never 'passed' without evidence
